Data Quality for Responsible AI in Energy Systems

DARES investigates the relationship between energy systems, data and AI, focusing on data quality for responsible AI in the green transition. As AI supports ambitious emissions goals, poor-quality data can undermine decisions and create risks for energy infrastructure.

Current data quality definitions remain vague, and systematic research into assessment is limited. DARES brings together an interdisciplinary Nordic-Baltic community to build regional expertise and advance socio-technical approaches to data quality.

Research outcomes

Policy recommendations

Comprehensive policy recommendations for data quality in responsible and sustainable AI development to support Nordic-Baltic green transition goals.

Data quality guidelines

Well-defined guidelines for data quality goals in data generation processes, AI system development pipelines, and AI system life-cycle for energy industries

Open tools and evaluation approaches.

Software libraries, benchmarks, toolkits, and evaluation approaches for incorporating data quality in synthetic data development and quality aware machine learning approaches.

Industry and policy workshops

Energy futures workshops for industry and policy makers engaging shared Nordic-Baltic values.
